name: phoenix-app
title: Phoenix API
blurb: Phoenix 1.8 JSON service on Elixir 1.18: pure counting module, endpoint-level ExUnit tests via Phoenix.ConnTest, 422/404 as contract

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: PORT=5417 mix phx.server >.phx.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 240); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5417/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .phx.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; body=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:5417/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:5417/stats); unknown=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5417/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; rm -f .phx.log; printf 'get=%s\nmissing=%s unknown=%s\n' "$body" "$missing" "$unknown"; test "$missing" = 422; test "$unknown" = 404; echo "$body" | grep -q '"lines":1'; echo "$body" | grep -q '"bytes":12'
